mapper.sql: s.id, s.season_id, se.season_name, se.match_id, m.match_name, s.stadium_id, st.stadium_name, st.address as stadium_address, st.capacity as stadium_capacity, st.contact_phone as stadium_contact_phone, st.photo_url as stadium_photo_url, st.status as stadium_status, st.remark as stadium_remark, s.schedule_name, s.status, s.start_time, s.create_time, s.update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM `schedule` s LEFT JOIN `season` se ON s.season_id = se.id AND se.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN `match` m ON se.match_id = m.id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN `stadium` st ON s.stadium_id = st.id AND st.deleted = 0 WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `schedule` ( season_id, stadium_id, schedule_name, status, start_time, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{seasonId}, #{stadiumId}, #{scheduleName}, #{status}, #{startTime}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE `schedule` SET season_id = #{seasonId}, stadium_id = #{stadiumId}, schedule_name = #{scheduleName}, status = #{status}, start_time = #{startTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE `schedule` SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select:
